title: Over after over. Out.
html_source: In the sport of cricket, an over is a set of six balls bowled from one end of a cricket pitch. A dismissal occurs when the batsman is out (also known as the fielding side taking a wicket and/or the batting side losing a wicket). There are 10 ways that a player can be given out in the game of cricket
